shortDefinition.en: The duration over which the camera collects light for an exposure, affecting motion rendering and exposure.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 相机为一次曝光收集光线的持续时间，影响运动呈现和曝光。

en: A fast shutter value does not guarantee correct focus or simultaneous readout of every sensor row.
zh-cn: 很快的快门数值不保证对焦正确，也不保证每行传感器同时读出。

example.en: Changing 1/125 s to 1/250 s halves the exposure duration.
example.zh-cn: 从 1/125 秒改为 1/250 秒，曝光时间减半。

sources.title: Camera Shutter Speed — Cambridge in Colour
sources.supports: The relationship between shutter duration and motion rendering.
